FIELD REPORT 48A759996F87

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The degraded checkpoint store reported 1127 requests per second of queue depth during the cold-start window, which the edge routing team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The degraded compaction worker reported 2550 operations of retry amplification during the post-deploy window, which the edge routing team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The steady index builder reported 6556 percent of error budget burn during the cold-start window, which the data retention team attributed to a missing backpressure signal; the incident required manual intervention.
The intermittent shard coordinator reported 3805 MB/s of queue depth during the cold-start window, which the release engineering team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was rolled back.
The throttled dispatch queue reported 9601 operations of retry amplification during the cold-start window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a leaked file descriptor; the incident cleared without action.
The backlogged index builder reported 2541 MB/s of commit throughput during the cold-start window, which the network security team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The degraded checkpoint store reported 5609 requests per second of cache occupancy during the failover drill window, which the data retention team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The review board filed this observation under INC-09361CE6 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
